queries.sql: WITH MonthlyAvg AS ( SELECT MONTH(pam.Interval) AS [Month], YEAR(pam.Interval) AS [Year], ROUND(AVG(CAST(pam.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS AvgAQI, MAX(CAST(pam.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)) AS MaxAQI FROM ParameterAveragesMonth pam JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pam.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pam.StationID = s.ID WHERE p.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND YEAR(pam.Interval) = @year GROUP BY MONTH(pam.Interval), YEAR(pam.Interval) ), WorstMonth AS ( SELECT TOP 1 * FROM MonthlyAvg ORDER BY AvgAQI DESC ), Exceedances AS ( SELECT p.ParameterName, COUNT(*) AS ExceedanceCount FROM ParameterAverages pa JOIN DMN_Parameters p ON pa.ParameterID = p.ID JOIN DMN_Stations s ON pa.StationID = s.ID JOIN Parameters_Excedence_Values ev ON ev.Parameter = p.ParameterName AND ev.Interval = 24 WHERE s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND MONTH(pa.Interval) = (SELECT [Month] FROM WorstMonth) AND YEAR(pa.Interval) = @year AND pa.Parametervalue > ev.ExcedenceValue AND pa.Status = 1 AND p.ParameterName <> 'AQI Index' GROUP BY p.ParameterName ) SELECT wm.[Month], wm.[Year], wm.AvgAQI, wm.MaxAQI, e.ParameterName, e.ExceedanceCount FROM WorstMonth wm CROSS JOIN Exceedances e ORDER BY e.ExceedanceCount DESC

s.StationName LIKE '%' + @stationName + '%' AND s.CoordinateX IS NOT NULL AND s.CoordinateY IS NOT NULL AND s.CoordinateX <> '' AND s.CoordinateY <> '' AND TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateX AS FLOAT) IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(s.CoordinateY AS FLOAT) IS NOT NULL ), IndoorAvg AS ( SELECT spa.StationID, ROUND(AVG(CAST(spa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS IndoorAvg, COUNT(*) AS IndoorReadingCount FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN IndoorSite i ON spa.StationID = i.SiteID WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND spa.ParameterName LIKE @parameterName AND CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) = CAST(@date AS DATE) GROUP BY spa.StationID ), NearestAmbient AS ( SELECT TOP 1 amb.Id AS AmbientStationID, amb.StationName AS AmbientStationName, ROUND(SQRT( ((amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) * ((amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) + ((amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32) * ((amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32) ), 2) AS Distance_km FROM AmbientStations amb CROSS JOIN IndoorSite i WHERE (amb.Status IS NULL OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(amb.Status))) = 'active') AND amb.Latitude IS NOT NULL AND amb.Longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SQRT( ((amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) * ((amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) + ((amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32) * ((amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32) ) ), OutdoorEventDay AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(ad.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS OutdoorDayAvg, COUNT(*) AS OutdoorReadingCount FROM AmbientData ad JOIN AmbientParameters ap ON ad.ParameterId = ap.Id JOIN NearestAmbient na ON ad.StationId = na.AmbientStationID WHERE ap.ParameterName LIKE @parameterName AND CAST(ad.ObservedAt AS DATE) = CAST(@date AS DATE) AND TRY_CAST(ad.ParameterValue AS FLOAT) IS NOT NULL ), OutdoorBaseline AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(DailyAvg), 1) AS OutdoorBaseline30 FROM ( SELECT CAST(ad.ObservedAt AS DATE) AS ReadingDate, AVG(CAST(ad.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)) AS DailyAvg FROM AmbientData ad JOIN AmbientParameters ap ON ad.ParameterId = ap.Id JOIN NearestAmbient na ON ad.StationId = na.AmbientStationID WHERE ap.ParameterName LIKE @parameterName AND CAST(ad.ObservedAt AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -30, @date) AS DATE) AND CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, @date) AS DATE) AND TRY_CAST(ad.ParameterValue AS FLOAT) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CAST(ad.ObservedAt AS DATE) ) DailyAverages ), IndoorBaseline AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(spa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS IndoorBaseline30 FROM SiteParameterAverages spa JOIN IndoorSite i ON spa.StationID = i.SiteID WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND spa.ParameterName LIKE @parameterName AND CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -30, @date) AS DATE) AND CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, @date) AS DATE) ) SELECT i.StationName AS IndoorSite, na.AmbientStationName AS NearestAmbientStation, na.Distance_km, CAST(@date AS DATE) AS EventDate, DATENAME(WEEKDAY, CAST(@date AS DATE)) AS DayOfWeek, @parameterName AS Parameter, ia.IndoorAvg, ia.IndoorReadingCount, oed.OutdoorDayAvg, oed.OutdoorReadingCount, ob.OutdoorBaseline30, ib.IndoorBaseline30, CASE WHEN oed.OutdoorDayAvg > 0 THEN ROUND(ia.IndoorAvg / oed.OutdoorDayAvg, 2) ELSE NULL END AS IORatio, CASE WHEN ob.OutdoorBaseline30 > 0 AND Also use when user asks how indoor air quality compared to outdoor on a past date or period at a residence. DATE RULES: if the user gives a single date, set startDate = endDate = that date. If they give a range, use those dates. If no date is given, default startDate to 30 days ago and endDate to yesterday.

i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) * ((amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) + ((amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32) * ((amb.Latitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) * ((amb.Longitude - i.Longitude) * COS(RADIANS((amb.Latitude + i.Latitude) / 2.0)) * 111.32) + ((amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32) * ((amb.Latitude - i.Latitude) * 111.32) ) ), OutdoorDailyMeans AS ( SELECT CAST(ad.ObservedAt AS DATE) AS ReadingDate, ROUND(AVG(CAST(ad.ParameterValue AS FLOAT)), 2) AS DailyMean FROM AmbientData ad JOIN AmbientParameters ap ON ad.ParameterId = ap.Id JOIN NearestAmbient na ON ad.StationId = na.AmbientStationID WHERE ap.ParameterName LIKE @parameterName AND CAST(ad.ObservedAt AS DATE) BETWEEN TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @startDate, 23) AND TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @endDate, 23) GROUP BY CAST(ad.ObservedAt AS DATE) ), OutdoorAvg AS ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(DailyMean), 2) AS OutdoorVal FROM OutdoorDailyMeans ) SELECT i.StationName AS ResidenceName, na.AmbientStationName AS NearestAmbientStation, na.Distance_km, @parameterName AS Parameter, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @startDate, 23) AS PeriodStart, TRY_CONVERT(DATE, @endDate, 23) AS PeriodEnd, ia.DayCount, ia.IndoorVal, oa.OutdoorVal, CASE WHEN oa.OutdoorVal > 0 THEN ROUND(ia.IndoorVal / oa.OutdoorVal, 2) ELSE NULL END AS IORatio FROM IndoorSite i LEFT JOIN IndoorAvg ia ON 1=1 CROSS JOIN NearestAmbient na LEFT JOIN OutdoorAvg oa ON 1=1

queries.sql: WITH DailyAQI AS ( SELECT spa.StationID, CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) AS ReadingDate, ROUND(MAX(CAST(spa.Parametervalue AS FLOAT)), 1) AS DailyAQI FROM SiteParameterAverages spa WHERE spa.TypeID = 14440 AND spa.ParameterName = 'AQI Index' AND spa.Parametervalue IS NOT NULL AND CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -30, GETDATE()) AS DATE) AND CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE) GROUP BY spa.StationID, CAST(spa.Interval AS DATE) ), ExceedanceSummary AS ( SELECT StationID, COUNT(*) AS TotalReadingDays, SUM(CASE WHEN DailyAQI > @aqiThreshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DaysExceeded FROM DailyAQI GROUP BY StationID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN DailyAQI > @aqiThreshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2 ), DeviceActivedays AS ( SELECT d.StationID, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(dc.RecordedDate AS DATE)) AS ActiveDays FROM DeviceCompliance dc JOIN DMN_Devices d ON dc.DeviceId = d.DeviceId WHERE dc.IsActive = 1 AND CAST(dc.RecordedDate AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -30, GETDATE()) AS DATE) AND CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, GETDATE()) AS DATE) GROUP BY d.StationID ) SELECT s.StationName, s.OrganizationName, s.Location, sec.SectorName, sub.SectorName AS SubSectorName, r.RegionName, es.DaysExceeded, es.TotalReadingDays, ISNULL(dad.ActiveDays, 0) AS DeviceActiveDays, ROUND(100.0 * ISNULL(dad.ActiveDays, 0) / 30.0, 1) AS DataSuccessRate_Pct FROM ExceedanceSummary es JOIN DMN_Stations s ON es.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN DeviceActivedays dad ON dad.StationID = s.ID LEFT JOIN Sectors sec ON s.SectorID = sec.Id LEFT JOIN SubSectors sub ON s.SubSectorID = sub.Id LEFT JOIN Regions r ON s.RegionID = r.Id WHERE ISNULL(s.IsDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ROUND(100.0 * ISNULL(dad.ActiveDays, 0) / 30.0, 1) >= @dsrThreshold ORDER BY es.DaysExceeded DESC, s.StationName
